summary: JWT not invalidated on user deletion — existing tokens remain valid until natural expiry (15m access / 7d refresh)
fix: Add incrementTokenVersion() call before DELETE in deleteUser()

summary: Backup restore imports password_hash from JSON without any integrity verification — tampered backup silently resets passwords
fix: Add backup signature check or require password re-confirmation after restore

summary: Player name regex allows \n\r (via \s) — enables log injection and breaks log parsing
fix: Replace \s with explicit space character in regex

summary: AI API error responses may leak API key prefixes or infrastructure details to end users
fix: Sanitize error messages: strip Bearer tokens and key patterns before returning to client

summary: Login endpoint skips CSRF protection — vulnerable to forced-login CSRF attacks
fix: Add one-time CSRF token or double-submit cookie for login endpoint

summary: Backup restore has no secondary confirmation — compromised admin account can wipe all data via restore
fix: Add explicit confirmation step (type 'RESTORE' or similar) for destructive operations

summary: Env-based admin/editor accounts (id=null) skip token revocation check — tokens can never be invalidated server-side
fix: Create DB records for env accounts or add Redis-based global token denylist

summary: ALLOWED_ORIGINS includes path (/tennis) that gets stripped — gives false impression of path-level CORS control
fix: Clean up env to use origin-only values; document CORS is origin-level

summary: detectApiFormat() probe failure leaves apiFormat=null forever — all subsequent requests use wrong format
fix: Set explicit default on probe failure; add AI_API_FORMAT env override

summary: Cursor pagination broken: WHERE m.id > $1 with ORDER BY play_date DESC returns same page repeatedly
fix: Use composite cursor (play_date, id) tuple comparison

summary: Redis reconnect loop has no jitter — multiple PM2 workers can cause connection storm on recovery
fix: Add random jitter (±25%) to reconnection delays

summary: PostgreSQL reconnect loop same issue — no jitter, potential connection storm
fix: Add random jitter to reconnection delays

summary: Public /health endpoint exposes PostgreSQL version, Redis status, pool sizes, system memory
fix: Return minimal status in production; move diagnostics to admin-only endpoint

summary: getRealClientIP() re-parses headers independently from Express trust proxy — may return different IP than req.ip
fix: Use req.ip consistently when trustProxy is enabled

summary: Bulk create invalidates cache inside loop before COMMIT — rollback leaves cache serving stale data for 4min
fix: Move cache invalidation to after successful COMMIT

summary: subpathNorm computed twice (lines ~349, ~363) — duplicate expression
fix: Extract to module-scoped constant

summary: maxSsePerIp computed on every SSE connection from static config value
fix: Hoist to module scope as constant

summary: Redis-Cache header set unconditionally on GET /seasons and GET /seasons/active (leaked in production)
fix: Add if (!config.isProduction) guard

summary: detectApiFormat() probe burns AI API tokens on every server restart
fix: Add AI_API_FORMAT env var override; skip probe for known providers

summary: Player name regex rejects hyphens and apostrophes — breaks international names
fix: Expand regex to include .'\- characters

summary: Match scores have no maximum validation — could cause integer overflow in rankings
fix: Add .isInt({ min: 0, max: 999 })

summary: Redis-Cache header on GET /seasons/active-one also lacks production guard
fix: Add if (!config.isProduction) guard
